stage_contract_semantics.instantiation: Every section tasks[stage] object is a concrete task. Its full objective is stage_contracts[stage].objective applied to that section's exact number/title and planning_subject; its deliverable and end conditions are the shared contract bound to the stated artifact. No 448 copied generic task bodies are necessary.
stage_contract_semantics.dependency_semantics: A stage task dependency means its relevant taxon output, not completion of the predecessor for every taxon/section. A missing input blocks only the dependent calculation or acceptance claim. Conditional dependencies apply only to the stated behavior.
stage_contract_semantics.taxon_instantiation: Each reviewed leaf gets the same eight stage contracts using its taxon ID prefix. Prepared hydronic seeds show the exact task-ID pattern and named ACCEPT endpoint. Combined seeds must split when source variants require independent evidence; no leaf is complete merely because the seed exists.
stage_contract_semantics.artifact_paths: All artifact paths are planned outputs, not assertions that those files already exist. Code/test write paths must be assigned by the coordinator before each bounded implementation dispatch; no worker owns shared implementation paths by this register.
stage_contract_semantics.acceptance_definition: The shared end conditions must be bound to complete declared taxon scope, exact source/fixtures, independent expected results and any numerical thresholds before each run. Tasks remain acceptance_definition_pending until those records are frozen; the fixed audit child is separately defined.

TAX.name: Source-backed taxonomy
TAX.objective: Enumerate the entire source section and its supported internal hierarchy
TAX.deliverable: A paragraph-to-taxon inventory with source spans, types/subtypes, service/material/size/joint attributes, relationships, referenced scope, exclusions, options and service obligations.
dependencies: Verified section identity; retrieve and pin the full applicable guide/specification text. A table-of-contents title is not the body.
For project applicability, obtain the exact project-adopted edition/revision; guide taxonomy preparation can proceed now.
end_condition: Every source part/paragraph has a reviewed disposition: taxon/attribute/relationship/reference/obligation/exclusion/option or explicitly justified non-scope text.
Each taxon has a stable ID, exact source locator and dimensional domain; unsupported branches, unread references and contradictory clauses remain named UNKNOWN work.
No invented CSI children or unsourced Cartesian combinations of material, service, size and joint.
Taxon-level tasks, exact expected outputs and remaining decisions are instantiated. Completion of this stage does not close the section.
A single-guide source audit may close independently; complete section TAX additionally requires a frozen complete declared scope/evidence set and resolution of its required taxon/child coverage gaps.

EVID.name: Drawing, schedule and specification producers
EVID.objective: Connect original-source evidence producers for every admitted taxon
EVID.deliverable: Source-bound drawing geometry, schedule cells, specification clauses and manual review records with IDs, role, revision, page/region and unresolved evidence states.
dependencies: Only the relevant taxon's TAX identity/attributes are required; other taxons need not wait.
Approved or public fixture documents with known provenance; original sources for any automated recognition acceptance.
Route scale/elevations only for measured taxons; counts and written obligations have no blanket scale prerequisite.
end_condition: Each taxon has a positive source example and an omitted/ambiguous/conflicting example with expected reviewed output.
Automated producer claims are tested on original drawing/specification inputs, not only manually injected detections.
Unknown identity, unmeasured routes, unread clauses and referenced-but-unsupplied documents produce visible unresolved records rather than zero.
Evidence can be opened from the connected workspace with exact source identity.

RULE.name: Approved counting and measuring boundaries
RULE.objective: Bind reviewed rules and adjudicated examples to the section's taxons
RULE.deliverable: An exact-hash rule packet, worked examples, exclusions/precedence decisions and owner-decision receipt per required new quantity behavior.
dependencies: Relevant TAX types and project scope choices, including guide options and responsibility boundaries.
New calculation boundaries need an owner decision; reuse unchanged approved equipment E01–E12/EC01–EC20 where applicable.
Rule preparation does not wait for full recognition or for other Division 23 sections.
end_condition: Every taxon is assigned an approved quantity basis or a documented non-quantity obligation output.
Count/measure basis, imperial units, work status, inclusions/exclusions, package membership and unknown handling have explicit examples.
Missing length/size/service or unchosen options never acquire default values or zero quantities.

Existing approved rules are hash-bound and reused. Examples introducing or changing quantity policy require an actual owner decision before quantity authority; additional fixtures under unchanged approved rules use independently established expected results and engineering verification.

CALC.name: Deterministic connected quantities
CALC.objective: Deliver deterministic quantity and obligation projections through the workspace
CALC.deliverable: A connected calculation/result contract with exact evidence/rule provenance and focused golden-case results for the section.
dependencies: Relevant EVID records and approved RULE inputs, not completion of unrelated taxons.
Current scale/dimension/elevation evidence for measured amounts; assembly membership and responsibility for procurement/installation projections.
For service or reference taxons, an obligation projection is the deliverable; do not invent material counts.
end_condition: Replaying exact source/rule inputs yields identical physical, package, installation and obligation results.
Every result contains source IDs, rule IDs, units and known/unresolved status; totals never silently absorb unknowns.
The connected app shows taxon rows and totals, including partial known amounts and unresolved components.
Adjudicated positive, exclusion, duplicate, missing-data and revision cases match exact expected values.

RECON.name: Requirements, assemblies and responsibility
RECON.objective: Reconcile written scope with physical evidence, packages and responsible parties
RECON.deliverable: Source-linked requirement/evidence/assembly crosslinks with supply, installation, trade/interface and reference-resolution states.
dependencies: Relevant TAX nodes and applicable source clauses; these may be linked before final quantities exist.
Physical identity evidence only for crosslinks that assert a particular instance; actual package/supply data only for those responsibility decisions.
end_condition: Each scoped requirement is satisfied by exact linked evidence, explicitly excluded by a sourced decision, or an actionable UNKNOWN obligation.
Schedule rows, plan appearances, internal package parts and referenced requirements are linked without duplicate purchases.
Supply, installation, low-voltage/line-power responsibility and service coverage remain separate when applicable.
A cross-reference never proves that the referenced section was supplied or fully supported.

EDIT.name: Corrections, revisions and reopen
EDIT.objective: Carry corrections and changed source/rule identities through taxon results and history
EDIT.deliverable: Append-only correction/revision/reopen evidence showing affected taxon records, regenerated quantities and retained prior states.
dependencies: The affected EVID/requirement records exist; CALC is required only to verify recalculated numeric outputs.
Exact changed source, taxon, assembly or rule identities; unchanged accepted inputs reuse existing evidence.
end_condition: Correcting identity/service/material/size/joint/geometry/option/responsibility updates only affected results.
Revised source/rule bytes make dependent decisions stale, retain history and require their proper re-review.
Save, close and reopen preserve current output and prior decisions without silent approval or double counting.
Unchanged sibling taxons/sections retain valid results; no wholesale restart.

OUT.name: Excel and source-linked evidence outputs
OUT.objective: Export the section's current quantities, obligations, unknowns and audit trail

dependencies: Current EVID/RECON records can export written requirements before every host quantity exists.

A source link opens the exact supporting page/region or clause after reopen.
